stories.summary: CNA Verify found Singapore is a prime target for coordinated disinformation because of its multiracial, multireligious society and open internet, with recent cases using fake AI-generated personas and news sites.
stories.title: CNA Explains: Why Singapore is a prime target for disinformation campaigns
stories.why: Singapore's openness makes it a test bed for influence operations — directly relevant to the information-warfare beat.

stories.summary: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese laid a wreath at the Changi Chapel and Museum early on Wednesday, honouring the 15,000 Australians interned at Changi, on his way to the COP31 climate summit in Türkiye.
stories.title: Albanese lays Remembrance Day wreath at Changi Chapel in Singapore
stories.why: Remembrance Day marked in Singapore at a site central to its wartime history.

stories.summary: DBS, OCBC and UOB's third-quarter results show a widening performance gap amid higher funding costs, prompting analysts to urge selective investment.
stories.title: Investors urged to be selective as Singapore banks' Q3 shows widening performance gap
stories.why: The three local banks are diverging — a read on Singapore's financial-sector health.

stories.summary: After a record year for real-estate deals, activity is expected to slow as higher borrowing costs widen pricing gaps and lengthen negotiations.
stories.title: Singapore real estate deal wave set to subside after record 2026 on higher borrowing costs
stories.why: A cooling signal for Singapore property after a record run.

stories.summary: An Endowus/Quinlan report found heavily regulated finance workers face strict personal-investment restrictions and pre-approval rules, with 18.8% reporting personal-account-dealing breaches.
stories.title: Investment restrictions weigh on Singapore's finance workforce
stories.why: The compliance burden is biting the people who run Singapore's finance industry.

stories.summary: Nvidia fell more than 6% on Tuesday, putting it on course to shed over $470bn in market value over two sessions; The Information reported the CEO's relationship with Alice Huang helped facilitate at least $7.5bn in chip shipments to Chinese firms via Singapore-registered Megaspeed.
stories.title: Nvidia sinks over 6%, heads for $470 billion two-day wipeout as CEO's affair row deepens
stories.why: The probe now threatens the world's most valuable chipmaker — and Singapore sits at the centre of the diversion allegations.

stories.summary: Anthropic is preparing an IPO targeting a valuation of up to $1.4tn, near SpaceX's record and potentially the largest ever, after reporting $9.8bn in annualised revenue; the offering could raise about $64.4bn.
stories.title: Anthropic IPO could be worth $1.4tn
stories.why: The biggest AI IPO ever would reset valuations across the sector.

stories.summary: Google began rolling out its November 2026 core update on Tuesday; the rollout is expected to take about two weeks and is designed to surface more satisfying content in Search.
stories.title: Google November 2026 Core Update Rolling Out
stories.why: A core update reshuffles search rankings for every site — including news publishers.

stories.summary: Singulus Technologies won a major contract to supply SpaceX with advanced heterojunction solar-cell manufacturing equipment.
stories.title: Singulus wins major supply contract with SpaceX for advanced HJT solar cell equipment
stories.why: SpaceX is extending its manufacturing reach into solar — a new supply-chain link for its satellite ambitions.

stories.summary: US consumer prices rose 0.4% in October (vs 0.3% expected) and core CPI rose 0.3% for a third straight month; Fed Governor Waller had said a 0.3% core print would justify considering a half-point December hike, and traders now price a December increase as near-certain.
stories.title: Even Fed doves float half-point hike after hot October CPI
stories.why: The last inflation reading before the Fed's December meeting has shifted the debate from whether to hike to how much.

stories.summary: Taiwan's foreign ministry said it will launch GUARD, a Global UAV Alliance for Resilience and Democracy, to facilitate technology exchange and secure drone supply chains.
stories.title: Taiwan to launch global drone alliance: ministry
stories.why: Drone supply chains are becoming a geopolitical battleground — and Taiwan wants to anchor a democratic alternative.

stories.summary: On day two of the B20 USA Summit in Washington, global business and policy leaders discussed investment, energy security, innovation and financial markets.
stories.title: Global business leaders tackle the priorities that will accelerate economic growth at B20 Summit
stories.why: The business agenda feeding into the G20 — a read on where global capital wants policy to go.

stories.summary: House Republicans voted 211–204 to refer the impeachment resolution to the Judiciary Committee, blocking a floor vote; the eight articles accused Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth of illegally waging the Iran war without congressional authorisation.
stories.title: U.S. Republicans derail bid to impeach Hegseth
stories.why: The Pentagon chief survives a rare intra-party challenge — and the Iran war's political fallout continues.

stories.summary: The US Justice Department unsealed an indictment charging three men with nearly 20 attacks and attempted attacks on Jewish targets in the US and Europe, including a planned assault on RAF Fairford, home to US bombers.
stories.title: US charges 3 Iran-backed operatives over attacks against Jews, plot targeting UK airbase
stories.why: The first detailed account of an alleged Iran-directed terror campaign reaching a US bomber base in Britain.

stories.summary: A 41-year-old senior US soldier was arrested near Gloucester on suspicion of assisting Russian intelligence under the UK Official Secrets Act, a day after US refuelling aircraft left a British base.
stories.title: US soldier arrested in UK for suspected 'espionage' for Russia
stories.why: A suspected insider case inside the US military in Britain — and a reminder of the counter-intelligence pressure around Ukraine-era deployments.

stories.summary: The Royal Navy selected Ocean Infinity as commercial mission partner for Atlantic Net, a contractor-operated surveillance network using uncrewed vessels, sensors and AI to protect undersea cables and pipelines.
stories.title: Royal Navy secures technology partner for Atlantic anti-submarine defence
stories.why: Undersea infrastructure protection is moving to autonomous, AI-run surveillance — a model other navies will watch.

stories.summary: The UK Parliament's Industry and Regulators Committee urged the government to move faster on the Strategic Defence Review's new government–defence industry relationship, warning the UK must be ready for military action within 1,000 days.
stories.title: Government must move at pace to be ready for military action in 1,000 days
stories.why: Parliament is pressing the government on whether Britain's defence-industrial base can actually deliver on its readiness pledge.

stories.summary: OSINT investigators at Golden Owl documented a Russian hybrid influence operation ahead of Spain's 29 November snap election, run through a Moscow-based hub that translates Kremlin narratives into Spanish, recruits operatives and pays cyber-volunteers in cryptocurrency; researchers examined about 55,000 posts and more than 10,000 accounts.
stories.title: Cyberattacks for cryptocurrency and bots from Asia: Russia is trying to influence elections in Spain
stories.why: A live case study of election interference in a NATO democracy — with recruitment, crypto payments and AI disinformation combined.

stories.summary: A Cyabra investigation found nearly 1 in 5 Election Day posts on X about five closely watched US races came from inauthentic accounts, with 8,344 suspicious accounts active between 20 October and 3 November spreading fabricated results.
stories.title: Report: Fake accounts spread false midterm results
stories.why: The first hard numbers on how much of the midterm conversation was fake — and a warning for 2028.

stories.summary: Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania are increasingly drawn into the cyber and information aspects of the Russia–Ukraine conflict, as Russia runs a protracted information-warfare campaign against the Baltic states.
stories.title: The Baltics States Are Being Drawn into the Ukrainian Information Warfare Conflict
stories.why: The information war is widening beyond Ukraine to NATO's eastern flank.

stories.summary: More than 100 US Navy Reserve information-warfare sailors trained at MAKO Sentry in Coronado on 5–8 November, the Navy reported, to strengthen fleet readiness through realistic information-warfare and maritime operations centre training.
stories.title: Reserve IW Sailors sharpen fleet readiness during MAKO Sentry
stories.why: The US Navy is building its reserve information-warfare bench — a sign of how central IW has become to fleet operations.

tldr: CNA Verify finds Singapore a prime target for coordinated disinformation, while Australia's PM marked Remembrance Day with a wreath at Changi Chapel.
Nvidia heads for a $470bn two-day wipeout as its CEO's alleged spy affair deepens, and Anthropic's IPO could be worth $1.4tn.
Hot October US inflation puts a December Fed hike — possibly a half-point move — firmly on the table.
The US House blocked a bid to impeach Defence Secretary Hegseth, and three Iran-backed operatives were charged over a plot on RAF Fairford.
A Russian hybrid operation targeting Spain's snap election was exposed, and fake accounts flooded X with false US midterm results.
